units.source_text: 这天打扮得花枝招展的艺伎、舞女来来往往，比往常任何时候都多。

en.t: On this day, gorgeously dressed geisha and dancers came and went, more numerous than at any ordinary time.

units.source_text: 稍稍提前的岁暮活动，把祇园周围点缀得绚丽多彩。

en.t: The slightly early year-end festivities adorned the area around Gion in brilliant colors.
